display_note: Earth rendered using historical NASA satellite composites. Cloud animation and sunlight are simulated; this is not live weather or a current satellite feed.

usage.attribution: Earth imagery: NASA Earth Observatory / NASA Goddard Space Flight Center. Blue Marble: Reto Stöckli; clouds: Reto Stöckli and Robert Simmon. Black Marble: Joshua Stevens, using Suomi NPP VIIRS data from Miguel Román, NASA GSFC.

projection.orientation: North at image top; west -180 at left; east +180 at right; Greenwich at horizontal midpoint. Global 2:1 aspect ratio.

assets.title: Blue Marble: Next Generation — July 2004 base map
assets.processing: Proportional downsample using macOS sips; no semantic image edits, generated details, clouds or lighting baked in.
assets.credit: NASA Earth Observatory, Blue Marble: Next Generation, Reto Stöckli / NASA Goddard Space Flight Center. Terra MODIS.

assets.title: Earth at Night / Black Marble 2016, grayscale global map
assets.processing: Unmodified NASA JPEG; recommended as shader emission mask, with simulated warm tint and nightside-only illumination.
assets.credit: NASA Earth Observatory images by Joshua Stevens, using Suomi NPP VIIRS data from Miguel Román, NASA GSFC.

assets.title: Blue Marble: Clouds (2002 release)
assets.processing: Unmodified NASA JPEG; grayscale brightness supplies cloud opacity. Two days of visible MODIS imagery plus thermal-infrared polar imagery. Historical composite, not live weather.
assets.credit: NASA Goddard Space Flight Center, Reto Stöckli (clouds), enhancements by Robert Simmon. MODIS Atmosphere Group.
